system.description:
Your artifact responds to your strength of character, much as any soldier would, and follows orders given with verve. Your spellcasting ability is Charisma. You use your Charisma and Charisma modifier for the purposes of your spellcasting and your bonded artifact feature.

While your artifact may be a @UUID[Compendium.a5e.a5e-class-features.Item.uga2gmf3559332tw]{Weapon of Power}, @UUID[Compendium.a5e.a5e-class-features.Item.l97xnqcpxnc12jpo]{Armor of Power}, or @UUID[Compendium.a5e.a5e-class-features.Item.00ein6jo2oc0asex]{Font of Power}, it always bears an insignia or symbol that represents you and your cause, which appears when you initially form your bond.
